# Villas Punta Uva

> Family-run private vacation villas in Punta Uva, Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, Limón, on the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica. Most villas are about a 5-minute walk from Playa Arrecife / Punta Uva Beach (Villa Cacha and Villa Carey about 7 minutes). Punta Uva Beach was ranked #41 on The World's 50 Best Beaches list for 2025.

The property has a shared infinity pool, yoga platform, gym, and free gated parking. A sister property, Villas Arrecife (Villa Cacha with its natural pool, and Villa Carey), is about a two-minute walk away. No 4x4 is needed: the villas are just off the paved main road.

## Villas

Sleeps = base capacity. Up to the max is allowed for a nightly extra-guest fee. Children under 5 stay free and don't count as guests.

- [Villa Mariposa](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-mariposa): 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, sleeps 10 (max 12), 2-night minimum
- [Villa Presidente](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-presidente): 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, sleeps 10 (max 12), 2-night minimum
- [Villa Cacha](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-cacha): 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, sleeps 6 (max 8), 2-night minimum, private natural pool
- [Villa Tucan](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-tucan): 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, sleeps 4 (max 6), 2-night minimum
- [Villa Angel](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-angel): 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, sleeps 4 (max 6), 2-night minimum
- [Villa Carey](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/carey-house): 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, sleeps 4 (max 5), no minimum stay
- [Villa Colibri](https://www.villaspuntauva.com/suites/villa-colibri): 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, sleeps 2 (max 3), no minimum stay

All villas are pet-friendly (for a nightly fee). Rates and availability are shown on each villa page.

## Booking

- Book directly by WhatsApp or text at +506 6145 9916, or email villaspuntauva@gmail.com.
- A 50% deposit confirms the reservation; the balance is due 14 days before arrival (1 month for long-term stays).
- Discounts: 10% for 7+ nights, 35% for 28+ nights, 10% for bookings within 7 days of arrival.
- Payment: Zelle, Interac e-Transfer, Wise, SINPE or bank transfer.
- The villas are also listed on Airbnb.
